bib.title: OCR-VQA: Visual Question Answering by Reading Text in Images

question: Can a VQA system answer questions about book covers by reading the text in the image with OCR?
contributions: Introduce the task of VQA by reading text in images (OCR-VQA)
Introduce OCR-VQA-200K, the first large-scale dataset for it
Baseline combining OCR and VQA components

method.summary: Dataset of 207,572 book-cover images with about 1M template/paraphrased QA pairs derived from cover metadata. Baseline detects up to 5 text blocks, OCRs them, tags entities, and feeds VGG-16, BLSTM question, word2vec and block features to a 51-way softmax classifier.
method.task: visual question answering requiring reading text (book covers)

datasets.name: OCR-VQA-200K
datasets.split: 80/10/10 images train/validation/test (text says 'train, test, and validation respectively', order inconsistent); approx 800K/100K/100K QA pairs
datasets.source: Images and metadata (author, title, genre) from Iwana et al. 2016 book cover dataset; questions from templates plus human paraphrase
datasets.preprocessing: Template questions on title, author, genre, year, edition, yes/no genre; annotators paraphrase; one of template or paraphrase chosen at random per image

models.name: BLOCK+CNN+W2V baseline
models.architecture: BLSTM question (300-d) + VGG-16 fc (4096-d) + mean word2vec of OCR text (300-d) + block features (35-d) -> concat 4731-d -> 2 FC layers of 1024 -> softmax over 51 outputs

other.outputs: 5 block index + 32 genre + 2 yes/no + 5 edition + 7 year = 51
other.text_blocks: max 5 largest, 5-d vector each (index, top-left, bottom-right xy); NER tag 2-d per block
other.OCR: TextSpotter (Gupta et al. 2016) chosen over Tesseract and CRNN
other.detectors compared: Tesseract segmentation with Otsu, EAST, VGG text detector + X-Y cut

other.note: Only the feed-forward network is trained; OCR and VGG are fixed

inference.decoding: argmax over 51-way softmax; title/author answers are returned as OCR text of the predicted block index (inferred from block-index output and look-up table)

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.definition: not defined beyond the name; per question type in Table IV

metrics.name: OCR recall
metrics.definition: fraction of correctly recognized words in author name and book title on validation set, optionally with minimum edit distance correction against a lexicon of all titles and authors

eval.protocol: Single run; no seeds or significance test stated

limits: Task is book covers only; authors plan to extend to scene text and born-digital images
Answers derive from metadata, so title/author correctness depends on metadata matching cover text; 'NULL' answers appear (Fig 4d)
Baseline is a 51-way classifier; title and author answered by block index lookup, not free-form generation
Lexicon-based edit-distance correction uses a lexicon of all titles and authors in the set, which inflates Table II
Split description lists test and validation in swapped order; Tables III-IV do not state the split
No seeds, variance or significance tests; accuracy undefined for multi-answer matching
Authors concede Scene-text VQA (ICDAR 2019 RRC) and TextVQA appeared after original submission; accuracy low from font/scale/layout variation, paraphrase and genre
